Resolves #21400

🌿 *A chart can no longer print its labels in white on a white page and still pass for drawn.*

An amCharts chart now draws its text in its Neo theme's colours. `wrapper.AmChart` resolves the amCharts theme from `getTheme()` through a `themeMap`, the shape the Monaco and Mermaid wrappers already use. It sends that theme with each create, and creates a mounted chart again when the theme changes. The AmCharts addon gives each chart its own theme list and leaves amCharts' global list empty between charts.

Evidence: L3 (browser-rendered fills measured in local Chrome against the page background) → L3 required (AC-1). No residuals.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Each chart keeps its own theme list.** The Fix asked the addon to clear the global list, apply the requested theme, then create. amCharts creates labels and legend items later, when the data arrives, and an object asks its parent for themes before the global list (`getCurrentThemes`, read in the running library). So the addon also writes the theme to `chart.themes`, and what the chart creates afterwards keeps the chart's theme even though the global list is empty again.
- **The COVID apps' theme button** swaps the theme class without setting `theme`, so a mounted chart is not told. That is unchanged here and filed as defect-note `5798d895`.

## Test Evidence

`examples/charts` in Chrome against this branch's dev server, every text node of the chart's SVG:

| Theme | Before (`dev`) | After |
|---|---|---|
| `neo-theme-light` (body `rgb(250, 250, 250)`) | 28 labels, fill `rgb(255, 255, 255)`: white on white | 28 labels, fill `rgb(0, 0, 0)`, contrast 20.12:1 |
| `neo-theme-dark` (viewport `rgb(43, 43, 43)`) | not re-measured: `dev` forces the dark theme on every chart, so this row read correctly before | 28 labels, fill `rgb(255, 255, 255)`, contrast 14.16:1 |

The dark row ran with the example's `themes` set to `["neo-theme-dark"]` locally; that change is not part of this PR.

**`examples/charts`, the whole page at 1440 × 900**, frames at `6274ff7248`:

| | Before (`dev`) | After (head) |
|---|---|---|
| `neo-theme-light` | ![before light](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/6274ff7248a1f28d8bde23d399a60ca270bcf3c1/review-evidence/21400/charts-before-light-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) | ![after light](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/6274ff7248a1f28d8bde23d399a60ca270bcf3c1/review-evidence/21400/charts-after-light-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) |
| `neo-theme-dark` | ![before dark](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/6274ff7248a1f28d8bde23d399a60ca270bcf3c1/review-evidence/21400/charts-before-dark-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) | ![after dark](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/6274ff7248a1f28d8bde23d399a60ca270bcf3c1/review-evidence/21400/charts-after-dark-1440x900.jpg?raw=true) |

Red proofs: both new specs against `dev`'s `AmChart.mjs` and `AmCharts.mjs` fail all 13 arms. The behavioural ones read:
- the first create sends no theme;
- a theme change creates nothing new (1 call, 3 expected);
- a light chart is built with `[am4themes_dark]` (`[]` expected);
- a chart carries no `themes` of its own.

Review round 1 (RA-2) adds four arms. Against the round-1 head `1fbb562a0c` all four fail:
- a theme change inside the 50 ms window sends one create, in the newer theme;
- an unmount inside the 50 ms window sends no create;
- a chart created again under its id replaces the one before it, which is disposed;
- a create that throws leaves no theme registered.

      **Details:** (1) Instead of a generation counter, `createChart()` holds an `AbortController` and passes its signal to `me.timeout(50, {signal})`. (2) `AmCharts#create` disposes a chart already under `data.id` before creating, and `createFromConfig` plus the `themes` assignment run in `try … finally { am4core.unuseAllThemes() }`. (3) Four new arms pin a theme switch and an unmount inside the window, re-creation under the same id, and a throwing create. All four fail against `1fbb562a0c`; both specs pass 17/17 at the head.

  1. In `AmChart`, add a `#mountGeneration` counter (incremented in `createChart()`, `afterSetMounted(false)`, and `destroy()`, following `MonacoEditor.mjs`) and check `generation === me.#mountGeneration && !me.isDestroyed && me.mounted && me.windowId === windowId` inside `me.timeout(50)` before calling `Neo.main.addon.AmCharts.create(opts)`. Currently, a theme change in `afterSetTheme` or an unmount/`destroy()` within 50 ms calls `AmCharts.destroy({id})` while chart #1 has not yet been created (a no-op on main), and then both 50 ms timers (or the stale unmount timer) dispatch `AmCharts.create`, leaking orphaned chart instances.

  3. Extend `test/playwright/unit/component/AmChartTheme.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/main/addon/AmChartsTheme.spec.mjs` to pin: theme switch and unmount within the 50 ms window emit at most one live `create` (zero after unmount), re-creating the same `data.id` disposes the prior chart, and a throwing `createFromConfig` leaves `registry.themes` empty.
